title: Privacy: admin can read all coach↔family 1:1s incl. read states and hidden media
expected: If full oversight is intended, parents/coaches should be told plainly that staff admins can read all chats and retrieve hidden attachments
actual: Admin sees every coach↔family 1:1 with per-coach read states ('Not read by the coach yet') and can 'View original' on media hidden as Inappropriate. Expected for oversight, but undisclosed to parents.
